modules.title: GDPR Compliance & Data Protection
modules.description: Comprehensive GDPR training covering lawful basis for processing, data subject rights, DPO responsibilities, and breach notification obligations.
learningObjectives: Understand the six lawful bases for processing personal data
Handle data subject access requests within regulatory timelines
Identify and report personal data breaches appropriately
Maintain GDPR-compliant records of processing activities

modules.title: European Leadership Excellence
modules.description: Leadership development tailored to European corporate cultures, covering consensus-building, works councils, co-determination, and cross-border team management.
learningObjectives: Navigate co-determination and works council processes in Germany, Netherlands, and Nordics
Lead across high-context and low-context European cultures
Apply situational leadership in European regulatory environments
Build cohesive multinational European teams

modules.title: Anti-Bribery & Corruption (UK Bribery Act)
modules.description: Compliance training aligned with the UK Bribery Act 2010, covering facilitation payments, gifts and hospitality, and third-party due diligence.
learningObjectives: Identify bribery and corruption risk scenarios
Apply the six adequate procedures for anti-bribery compliance
Manage gifts, hospitality, and entertainment within policy
Conduct due diligence on third parties and agents
modules.audience: All UK-based employees; global employees with UK exposure

modules.title: Diversity & Inclusion in Europe
modules.description: Practical DEI training addressing Europe's specific diversity dimensions including nationality, religion, age, and disability within EU anti-discrimination framework.
learningObjectives: Understand EU equal treatment directives and national implementations
Address discrimination on the nine protected characteristics
Build inclusive practices in multilingual, multinational teams
Support neurodiversity and disability inclusion

modules.title: German Business Culture & Etiquette
modules.description: Essential cultural intelligence training for professionals working with German colleagues and clients, covering communication norms, meeting culture, and hierarchy.
learningObjectives: Navigate formal communication and hierarchy norms in German business
Conduct effective meetings aligned with German expectations
Understand the role of Betriebsrat (works council) in operations
Build trust with German business partners
modules.audience: International employees working with German teams

modules.title: Sustainability & EU Green Deal
modules.description: Training on the European Green Deal, Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), and Taxonomy Regulation, and their impact on business operations.
learningObjectives: Understand the European Green Deal strategic objectives
Navigate CSRD reporting obligations
Apply EU Taxonomy for sustainable activities
Reduce organizational carbon footprint

modules.title: Working Time Regulations & Employee Rights
modules.description: HR compliance training on EU Working Time Directive, national implementations, rest periods, and employee rights to disconnect.
learningObjectives: Apply EU Working Time Directive requirements
Manage overtime and rest period obligations
Respect employees' right to disconnect
Maintain compliant time recording

modules.title: French Business Communication
modules.description: Cultural and communication training for professionals engaging with French colleagues and clients, covering formality, intellectual culture, and negotiation style.
learningObjectives: Use appropriate formal and informal registers in French business
Navigate intellectual debate culture in French meetings
Understand French labor relations context
Build effective working relationships with French stakeholders
modules.audience: International employees working with French teams

modules.title: AI & Ethics in the Workplace
modules.description: Training on responsible AI use aligned with the EU AI Act, covering risk assessment, algorithmic transparency, and human oversight.
learningObjectives: Understand the EU AI Act risk classification system
Apply ethical AI principles in decision-making
Identify and mitigate AI bias
Maintain human oversight in AI-assisted processes

modules.title: Health & Safety at Work (EU Standards)
modules.description: EU Framework Directive-aligned workplace health and safety training, covering risk assessment, DSE (display screen equipment), and ergonomics.
learningObjectives: Conduct workplace risk assessments
Apply EU health and safety framework requirements
Set up ergonomic display screen workstations
Prevent and report workplace accidents

modules.title: Cross-Cultural Communication in Europe
modules.description: Navigating the diverse cultural landscape of Europe — from Nordic directness to Mediterranean relationship-focus — for effective pan-European collaboration.
learningObjectives: Map cultural dimensions across European nations (Hofstede framework)
Adapt communication style to different European cultures
Facilitate effective meetings in multicultural European teams
Resolve cross-cultural misunderstandings constructively

modules.title: Digital Skills for the Modern Workplace
modules.description: Aligned with the EU DigComp 2.2 framework, this module builds foundational digital competencies for all employees.
learningObjectives: Navigate digital tools for information and data literacy
Communicate and collaborate effectively in digital environments
Create and edit digital content responsibly
Solve problems with digital tools and resources

modules.title: Financial Services Compliance (MiFID II)
modules.description: MiFID II regulatory training for financial services professionals covering client classification, suitability, best execution, and product governance.
learningObjectives: Apply MiFID II client categorization rules
Conduct suitability and appropriateness assessments
Meet best execution obligations
Adhere to product governance requirements

modules.title: Whistleblowing & Speak-Up Culture
modules.description: EU Whistleblower Directive-aligned training on reporting channels, protections for whistleblowers, and fostering a speak-up culture.
learningObjectives: Understand whistleblower protections under EU Directive 2019/1937
Use internal and external reporting channels appropriately
Recognize and avoid retaliation against reporters
Support a transparent, speak-up culture

modules.title: Resilience & Stress Management
modules.description: Evidence-based resilience training helping employees manage workplace stress, prevent burnout, and maintain wellbeing.
learningObjectives: Identify personal stress triggers and warning signs
Apply cognitive-behavioral techniques for stress management
Build sustainable work habits and boundaries
Support colleagues experiencing stress

modules.title: Sales Excellence in European Markets
modules.description: Develop consultative selling skills tailored to European B2B markets, including relationship-building, complex sales cycles, and procurement dynamics.
learningObjectives: Apply consultative selling methodology in B2B European contexts
Navigate complex multi-stakeholder procurement processes
Adapt sales approach to cultural expectations across Europe
Build long-term strategic customer relationships

modules.title: Coaching & Mentoring Skills
modules.description: Develop coaching and mentoring competencies to unlock team performance and support employee development.
learningObjectives: Apply GROW coaching model in 1:1 conversations
Practice active listening and powerful questioning
Structure effective mentoring relationships
Give and receive developmental feedback

modules.title: Project Management Professional (PMP Prep)
modules.description: Comprehensive project management training aligned with PMI PMBOK Guide, preparing participants for PMP certification.
learningObjectives: Apply the five process groups and ten knowledge areas of PMBOK
Develop project charters, WBS, and risk registers
Manage stakeholders, scope, schedule, and budget
Lead project teams through complex delivery challenges

modules.title: Intercultural Intelligence (CQ)
modules.description: Advanced Cultural Intelligence (CQ) development program using the CQ framework to build adaptive capability in diverse global environments.
learningObjectives: Assess and develop the four CQ capabilities: Drive, Knowledge, Strategy, Action
Adapt leadership and communication style to cultural context
Navigate ambiguity and uncertainty in multicultural settings
Build inclusive practices that leverage cultural diversity

modules.title: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) & KYC

learningObjectives: Identify money laundering and terrorist financing red flags

File Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) appropriately
Maintain AML compliance records
